player_prompt.intro:
Keddi Player {player_id} deg iman n Poker n Hind.
- 52-kart tamawt; kattanfat adrar n imaslaɣ deg kart n imaslaɣ.
- Ante {ante} chip(s) kul adrar, {max_rounds} adrar(s) aked.
- Imyaten iman: '[check]'  |  '[bet X]'  |  '[call]'  |  '[raise X]'  |  '[fold]'  (X d azgen aɣelsan ≤ chip nnek.)
- Kart n imaslaɣ n iman iɣelnawen tewhid iman n pot deg showdown.
